instruction: Create a systemd timer that runs daily at 3 AM
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/daily-backup.timer <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Daily backup timer

[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF

instruction: Create a service unit triggered by the daily timer
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/daily-backup.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Daily backup job

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/backup.sh
EOF

instruction: Create a timer that runs 15 minutes after boot
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/ondelay.timer <<'EOF'
[Timer]
OnBootSec=15min
Unit=myapp.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF

instruction: Create a timer that runs every hour with jitter
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/hourly-check.timer <<'EOF'
[Timer]
OnCalendar=hourly
RandomizedDelaySec=300

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF

instruction: Create a timer that runs every Monday at midnight
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/weekly-report.timer <<'EOF'
[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon *-*-* 00:00:00

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF

instruction: Create a path unit that watches a directory for changes
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/watchdir.path <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Watch /data/incoming

[Path]
PathModified=/data/incoming
Unit=proc-incoming.service

[Install]
WantedBy=paths.target
EOF

instruction: Create a service triggered by the path watcher
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/proc-incoming.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Process incoming files

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/process.sh
EOF

instruction: Create a path unit that triggers on file creation only
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/oncreate.path <<'EOF'
[Path]
PathExists=/data/signal.txt
Unit=oncreate-handler.service

[Install]
WantedBy=paths.target
EOF

instruction: Create a socket unit for a systemd-activated service
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/echo.socket <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Echo socket

[Socket]
ListenStream=7777
Accept=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=sockets.target
EOF

instruction: Create a service for socket-activated echo server
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/echo@.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Echo connection %i

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/cat
StandardInput=socket
StandardOutput=socket
EOF

instruction: Create a socket unit listening on a Unix socket
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/myapp.socket <<'EOF'
[Socket]
ListenStream=/run/myapp.sock
SocketMode=0660
SocketUser=myapp

[Install]
WantedBy=sockets.target
EOF

instruction: Activate and start all timer units
output: sudo systemctl enable --now daily-backup.timer

instruction: List all timer units with their next elapse time
output: systemctl list-timers --all

instruction: Show detailed timer properties
output: systemctl show daily-backup.timer

instruction: Test what a calendar expression would resolve to
output: systemd-analyze calendar '*-*-* 00,12:00:00'

instruction: Show timer calendar expressions in verbose format
output: systemctl show daily-backup.timer -p OnCalendar --value

instruction: Create a monotonic timer that runs 1 hour after boot
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/boot-delay.timer <<'EOF'
[Timer]
OnBootSec=1h

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF

instruction: Create a timer that runs after the previous invocation completes plus 30 min
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/interval.timer <<'EOF'
[Timer]
OnUnitActiveSec=30min

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF

instruction: Activate a path unit immediately
output: sudo systemctl enable --now watchdir.path

instruction: Start a socket unit and make it listen
output: sudo systemctl start echo.socket

instruction: Check if a socket unit is listening
output: ss -tlnp | grep 7777

instruction: Disable and stop a timer permanently
output: sudo systemctl disable --now daily-backup.timer

instruction: Re-generate all timer symlinks without enabling
output: sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl reenable daily-backup.timer

instruction: Create a path unit that watches a file then stops triggering
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/watchnot.path <<'EOF'
[Path]
PathChanged=/tmp/watchfile
MadeDirectory=/tmp/watchdir

[Install]
WantedBy=paths.target
EOF
